verdict.rationale: SumUp publishes extensive developer documentation covering checkout creation, refunds, webhooks, terminal Cloud API, and JS/TS SDKs, with sandbox testing support and API-key auth, and an independent developer confirms building on the public API in production. This clearly satisfies a documented, drivable public API for AI-native or programmatic use. missing for 10: a formal machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probe shows 404s for standard OpenAPI endpoints), broader independent hands-on confirmation beyond one anecdote.
